mapper.insert: insert into t_warning_handle_log ( warn_id, action_type, opinion, attachment_urls, before_status, after_status, handler_name, handle_time, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{warnId}, #{actionType}, #{opinion}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{handlerName}, #{handleTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select log_id, warn_id, action_type, opinion, attachment_urls, before_status, after_status, handler_name, handle_time from t_warning_handle_log where warn_id = #{warnId} order by handle_time desc, log_id desc
